title: BEST Way to Find Diamonds in Minecraft!
transcript:
When playing Minecraft, sometimes it can
be hard searching for diamonds,
especially if you're a new player. But
the best way to get a lot of diamonds is
simple. Make sure you're at Y level 58.
You can begin strip mining at this
point, and eventually you'll find
diamonds. And sometimes, if you're
lucky, you can find an eight vein, which
is insanely rare. Just look at me. Hey,
I'm dripped out in diamond armor.
summary: Transcript evidence suggests: branch/strip mining. Mentioned Y levels: 58.
